# BLDS agent-readable index

> Generated from the repository-owned BLDS contracts. This index is a read-only discovery surface; it is not semantic authority.

## Authority

- Semantic SSOT: `contracts/blab.design.yaml`
- Registry: `agent-registry.v1.json`
- Query contract: repository-local and read-only
- Remote mutation: forbidden

## Components

- [BLabButton](agent-docs/components/button.md) — Primary, secondary, and destructive action control.
- [BLabTextField](agent-docs/components/text-field.md) — Single-line and multiline text input with helper, error, read-only, and clear-action semantics.
- [BLabSegmentedControl](agent-docs/components/segmented-control.md) — Controlled selection among a small set of mutually exclusive options.
- [BLabTabBar](agent-docs/components/tab-bar.md) — Controlled in-screen navigation across a small set of tabs.
- [BLabBottomBar](agent-docs/components/bottom-bar.md) — Bottom navigation with selected, focus, drag, optional action, and localized label behavior.
- [BLabPressableWrapper](agent-docs/components/pressable-wrapper.md) — Interaction primitive for press, hover, focus, and action-derived semantics.
- [BLabCard](agent-docs/components/card.md) — Glass surface container that may become actionable when an explicit action is supplied.
- [BLabSnackbar](agent-docs/components/snackbar.md) — Transient feedback surface for success, error, warning, and info messages.
- [BLabKeyboardAccessoryBar](agent-docs/components/keyboard-accessory-bar.md) — Keyboard accessory actions for navigation, editing, and completion.

## Interpretation rules

- `required` means the state is required by the design contract.
- `conditional` means the state needs its documented runtime or API condition.
- `not_applicable` means the component must not simulate that state.
- Missing or unverified evidence must be reported as not claimed.
